currentContext.expansion: The annual report discloses no named capex or capacity-addition project for KMC Speciality Hospitals for FY2025-26. Physically the Company remains a two-unit operator in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu — the Cantonment Unit at No. 6 Royal Road and the Maa Kauvery unit at No. 27 Alexandria Road — together with two offices, all national, with no international locations (BRSR Section A, items 18 and 19). Expansion in FY26 was capability- and technology-led rather than bricks-and-mortar: management reports scaling up the Connected ICU program for real-time monitoring of critical patients through advanced sensors and digital platforms; rolling out new emergency capabilities on the Kauvery Kare App; a Post Discharge Care Program; elevated Robotic Process Automation supported by Kauvery's own team; AI and OCR-enabled invoice and GRN automation; implementation of Oracle Fusion for Finance and Purchase as a unified cloud-based ERP; and a dedicated Procurement ERP for Pharmacy and General Stores. On the energy side the Company has adopted group captive renewable sources — windmills and solar, around 92% of the total energy mix — plus Brushless DC fans, star-rated HVAC, variable frequency drive controlled Air Handling Units and a Building Management System in one of its units, and is targeting a shift to 100% renewable energy usage from the next financial year. Forward-looking capacity intent is limited to management naming 'Expansion into Quaternary Care' and 'Opportunity for horizontal and vertical growth' among opportunities in the MD&A; neither carries a project name, site or timeline. No rupee capex quantum arrives in this bundle under a '=== NAMED DISCLOSURE ===' heading, so no capex figure is reported here.
